func@X call(val: Int@X) {}

func@(A,B) foo() {
  let x: func@A(Int@A) = call@A;
  let y: func@B(Int@B) = call@B;

  let val = 10;
  x(val);
  y(val);
}
---
(source-file
  (func
    (func-sig
      (role-type
        (role X)) call
      (params
        (param val
          (named-type Int
            (role-type
              (role X))))))
    (scope "{" "}"))
  (func
    (func-sig
      (role-type
        (role A)
        (role B)) foo
      (params))
    (scope "{"
      (let x
        (type
          (closure-type
            (role-type
              (role A))
            (type-params
              (named-type Int
                (role-type
                  (role A))))))
        (at call
          (role-type
            (role A))) ";")
      (let y
        (type
          (closure-type
            (role-type
              (role B))
            (type-params
              (named-type Int
                (role-type
                  (role B))))))
        (at call
          (role-type
            (role B))) ";")
      (let val
        (int 10) ";")
      (expr
        (call x val ")") ";")
      (expr
        (call y val ")") ";") "}")))
